policy.reason: No externally justified absolute production runtime or tail threshold exists for the frozen RB1 scope. F-RB01 therefore characterizes cost and scaling honestly and does not manufacture a post-hoc threshold.

evidence.scope: restricted parallel V1 wall-clock scaling, 32 logical columns, batch_size=9, frozen V1 profile
evidence.interpretation: Two-worker scaling is reproducibly positive on the frozen fixture. Four-worker scaling is positive but not robust in magnitude and is host/runtime sensitive on the small workload.
Rejected trials can be materially more expensive than the admitted accepted baseline. No representative accepted p50/p95/p99 tail distribution or bounded-cost threshold is established.

evidence.scope: historically qualified worker scratch de-duplication in frozen parallel V1 scope
evidence.interpretation: Demonstrates the architecture's worker-owned scratch reduction direction. Exact byte figures belong to the qualified F-PE08 postimage and are not silently asserted as current-RB1 exact payload after later source evolution.
nonclaims: no current exact payload claim from this historical fixture

evidence.scope: exact-shape worker parameter/forcing cache reuse in frozen V1 scope
evidence.interpretation: Qualified worker-local exact-shape reuse with full refresh/recompute and no persistent per-column cache state; timing is runner-bound only.

evidence.scope: forcing-only trial-scoped direct immutable view research/qualification
evidence.interpretation: Copy elimination was real but worker-scaled and too small without attributable runtime benefit to justify added alias-lifetime complexity. Evidence is retained, candidate is not an RB1 capability.

evidence.scope: surface-evaporation local materialization microkernel allocation/ownership improvement
evidence.interpretation: Local runner-bound microkernel improvement retained in current canonical without changing surface-evaporation science, transaction semantics or mass policy.

rb1_release_interpretation.allocations: LOCAL_SURFACE_MATERIALIZATION_COPY_CHURN_REDUCED; OTHER CALL-LOCAL/WORKER ALLOCATION COSTS ARE NOT GENERALIZED INTO A RELEASE CLAIM
rb1_release_interpretation.serialized_vs_parallel: 2-worker positive scaling demonstrated on bounded fixture; 4-worker magnitude explicitly variable

hard_nonclaim: RB1 production viability means a scientifically qualified, deterministic, mass-conserving restricted runtime with bounded declared execution profiles and measured performance characteristics. It does not mean universal speedup, a hardware-independent SLA or solved difficult-column tail policy.
